fields.description: What this box backs — the doctype of the same name, plus the word Server where it has one. Drives its Network security-group list on AWS; informational on bare-metal.
fields.label: Machine Type
fields.options:
Gateway
Ingress
Inference
Monitoring Agent
State Store

fields.description: Source of truth; Proxy/Inference Servers on this machine inherit it. Derived from Network when one is linked and has a Region set.
fields.label: Region

fields.description: From the Region, set on save: a Machine derives its region from its Network during validate, after link fetching has run.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: AWS: drives this box's subnet, security groups and region. Bare-metal: optional — a bare-metal box's ports are open by default, so this can point at a placeholder Network with everything left blank, or stay unset.
fields.label: Network

fields.description: Provider to use for provisioning (e.g. AWS). Blank = manual/on-prem.
fields.label: Cloud Provider

fields.description: Bare-metal: type the box's address here. Cloud: read-only — the provider hands it out, and Provision/Sync/Start write it.
fields.label: Public IP

fields.description: Key authorised on this box. Blank = the control plane's own local key (what Ansible connects with by default). Frozen once the box is launched — the keys go in at launch, so a later change here would only make this doc disagree with the box.
fields.label: SSH Key

fields.description: Launch spec for this box. Blank fields fall back to the Cloud Provider's account-wide default.
fields.label: Cloud

fields.description: e.g. g6.12xlarge. Its GPUs seed the table below at provision.
fields.label: Instance Type

fields.description: The only disk attached. Holds the OS, the engine images AND the model weights, so size it for every model this box will serve — weights are hundreds of GB and the local NVMe is not used for them.
fields.label: Root Volume (GB)

fields.description: Give this box an Elastic IP, so its address survives a Stop — AWS re-issues a different one on every Start otherwise, stranding every route and SSH config pointing at the old address. Billed while held; handed back on Terminate. Tick before Provision to launch with one; on a running box use the Attach/Release Static IP buttons, which own this box then.
fields.label: Static IP

fields.description: The Elastic IP this box holds. Released by the Release Static IP button, or by Terminate.
fields.label: Static IP Allocation ID

fields.description: AMI to launch from. Editable while this box is Pending — after that it is what the box was launched with, and Sync keeps it in step with the instance.
fields.label: Machine Image

fields.description: What this box runs, read off its instance type. An Engine Image is matched against it — an arm64 box needs an arm64 image and an arm64 AMI. Blank on-prem.
fields.label: CPU Architecture

fields.description: Whether this instance type is a .metal SKU. Bare metal spends ten to twenty minutes in firmware POST on every boot and every reboot, so Grove waits longer for it — at launch, at start, and at the driver reboot during Setup.
fields.label: Bare Metal

fields.description: Ephemeral local NVMe this instance type ships. Wiped on stop and terminate — survives a reboot only. Unmounted unless the Inference Server opts its HF cache onto it (Use Instance Store For HF Cache).
fields.label: Instance Store Disks

fields.description: The cards in this box. Read-only, and rewritten by Scan GPUs alongside the GPU records themselves — one writer, so this grid cannot drift from them. Open a row's GPU to see its history and what holds it.
fields.label: GPUs

fields.description: How the cards reach each other, off nvidia-smi topo. Blank until Scan GPUs runs, and on a one-card box.
fields.label: GPU Interconnect
